Hyundai Announces Bayon Launch in India with 1.5‑L MPi Engine and Intelligent Variable Transmission

30 Oct 2026, 07:33 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Auto Desk · Source: www.hyundai.com

Key takeaways Hyundai Bayon Set for Indian Debut on 26 October 2026 Hyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) unveiled the performance philosophy of its upcoming **Hyundai Bayon** on 23 October 2026. The compact Intelligent Utility Vehicle (IUV) will be launched across India on 26 October

Hyundai Bayon Set for Indian Debut on 26 October 2026

Hyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) unveiled the performance philosophy of its upcoming Hyundai Bayon on 23 October 2026. The compact Intelligent Utility Vehicle (IUV) will be launched across India on 26 October 2026, with bookings already open through Hyundai’s official website (www.hyundai.co.in) and at authorised dealerships.

Powertrain: Proven 1.5‑L MPi Petrol Engine

The Bayon is built around Hyundai’s four‑cylinder 1.5 L MPi petrol engine, a powertrain that has powered more than 600,000 Hyundai vehicles in India since 2020. The engine delivers 84.4 kW (115 PS) of peak power and 143.8 Nm (14.7 kgm) of torque. Hyundai cites the engine’s long‑standing reliability and refinement as key reasons for its selection, positioning it as a “trusted” power unit for everyday Indian driving conditions.

Transmission Choices: 6‑Speed Manual or Intelligent Variable Transmission (iVT)

Buyers will be able to choose between a conventional 6‑speed manual transmission (6MT) and Hyundai’s Intelligent Variable Transmission (iVT). The iVT is described as a continuously variable transmission that blends smooth power delivery with efficiency. When paired with the iVT, the Bayon gains access to a suite of performance‑enhancing functions:

  • Dash Boost Mode – an instant power‑boost for quicker acceleration, useful during overtaking.
  • Sporty Drive Tech – a sportier acceleration profile that makes the vehicle feel more engaging.
  • Paddle shifters – steering‑mounted controls that let drivers manually select gear ratios without using a clutch.
  • Three selectable drive modes – Eco (fuel‑efficiency focus), Normal (balanced), and Sport (performance‑oriented). The modes are switched via a steering‑mounted button.

Executive Comment

Tarun Garg, Managing Director & CEO of HMIL, said: > “At Hyundai, we believe performance is not defined solely by power figures, but by how naturally and confidently a vehicle responds to the driver in everyday situations. With Hyundai Bayon, we have combined our trusted four‑cylinder 1.5 L MPi petrol engine with intelligent driving technologies to deliver a driving experience that feels smooth, responsive and engaging across a variety of road conditions… Guided by our philosophy of ‘Intelligence That Moves’, Hyundai Bayon delivers a refined and intuitive driving experience designed for the evolving expectations of Indian customers.”

Practical Implications for Indian Buyers

  • Urban suitability – The modest displacement and smooth iVT operation promise low‑fuel‑consumption city driving, while Eco mode further optimises mileage.
  • Highway confidence – Dash Boost and Sport mode aim to reduce the perceived lag often associated with CVTs, offering more decisive overtaking power on expressways.
  • Pricing and booking – The initial booking amount is ₹11,000, payable online or at a dealership. Full pricing details have not been disclosed in the press release.
  • Delivery timeline – HMIL indicates that deliveries will begin during the festive season (typically November‑December), with exact dates to be communicated at launch.

How Readers Can Verify the Announcement

The full press release is hosted on Hyundai’s official Indian media centre: [https://www.hyundai.com/in/en/hyundai-story/media-center/press-release/performance-on-with-hyundai-bayon](https://www.hyundai.com/in/en/hyundai-story/media-center/press-release/performance-on-with-hyundai-bayon) Readers can also check the Hyundai India website (www.hyundai.co.in) for booking portals, variant listings, and any subsequent updates on pricing or delivery schedules.
